ITT: nobody who knows why self-pump gas exists.... Let me explain....

Back in the day, ALL gas pumps were full service. They'd pump your gas for you, they'd wash your windows for you, and they'd even change your oil for you, if you asked them to. As a customer, they handled everything for you... think about going to a restaurant and having the waiter/waitress take your order, deliver it to the cook, bring you your drinks, and bring your food from the kitchen to you.

Well, one day, all the major stations offered a deal: a discount on gas if you pumped your own. They'd take a cent, or two, (which was more than 10-20% back then) off of your gas if you could pump it for yourself. They don't have to pay a gas station attendant to do it, and you save money... good deal, right? This would be tantamount to removing the waiters/waitresses, and asking you to do all that work for yourself, with a $2 discount on your steak dinner.

Well, given enough time, everyone's forgotten about the discount, gas prices have gone WAY up, and we're all still pumping our own gas. The gas companies are pocketing that money, by having a single attendant on duty, and we have to pump our own gas in the cold/hot. This is where waiters/waitresses don't exist anymore, the restaurants have stopped giving you that discount, and you just accept that it's your "job" to get your own food...

And, here's the kicker: It's happening again! In grocery stores, they're offering you ring up your goods and bag them yourself... In coffee shops, they're "letting" you cashier yourself, "take" your own order, and "handle" the money yourself... In banks, they "encourage" you to use online interfaces and ATMs instead of going in to speak to a teller, even to the point they "penalize" you for speaking to a human teller, with some banks...

In the whole world, you're being offered "conveniency" in the form of faster checkouts and monetary discounts, but you've always had the option... But, now, the options are all going away... and we're all going to be volunteer gas station workers, volunteer baristas, volunteer cashiers, volunteer bag-boys, volunteer bank tellers, and god knows what else... all for no pay, while the business owners pocket the money that would have been paying employees.
